title: W0 Run Admission Attestation
description: Operator-external signed pre-execution admission consumed only by pinned bootstrap ADMIT after run authorization. It authorizes semantic ADMIT validation and the later authority-controlled readiness sequence; it does not claim an assigned worker has already launched or loaded. Exact authority-monitored external temp, challenge, and proof writes from PREPARE/VALIDATE are bootstrap operations and do not satisfy or violate sideEffectsStarted. The same authority session/monitor lock has no gap from prelaunch through VALIDATE, external human authorization, semantic ADMIT PASS, atomic token consumption, suspended/pre-entry worker observation, signed admit-execution receipt verification, bootstrap PASS, and worker-ready capability consumption immediately before the first effect. Every authorization artifact is outside the locked project and is exact-covered by a separately hashed external input extension; this attestation/signature and the future admit-execution receipt/signature are the exact four proof-sealing exclusions. It re-observes current project/B2/package/WP bytes and identities, exact W0-derived frozen paths, receiver Skill tree, the human-approved expected process closure, all scope digests, chronology, active enforcement readiness, zero implementation side effects, and a one-time short-lived admission token. Actual worker closure belongs only in the post-semantic signed receipt. Direct/early worker launch, project-local authorization evidence, lock gap, derived-set/tree mismatch, expiry, replay, or inability to sign is W0 rerun/STOP.

operatorExpectedConfigSha256.description: ADMIT argv scalar independently authorized out-of-band; exact-matches challenge/PREPARE/pre/post and actual configSha256 before parsing.

configSha256.description: ADMIT-time recomputed raw config hash, equal to operatorExpectedConfigSha256.

authorizationInputExtension.description: artifactSetSha256 is canonical JSON over ordinal-absolute-path-sorted unique closed {path,bytes,sha256} for the presentation, challenge, transcript, statement, capture, capture PV, run authorization, transfer approval, PV signature evidence, and every transitively referenced external input. artifactIdentitySetSha256 uses the same paths as {path,volumeIdentity,fileIdentity}. The admission bytes/signature and future admit-execution receipt/signature are the exact four exclusions needed to break creation-order cycles; all four paths are independently predeclared, identity-disjoint, and locked, while each existing artifact is separately rehashed and signature-verified.

skillSha256.description: Raw SHA-256 of the exact assigned receiver Skill entrypoint bytes at scopeCore.assignedReceiver.skill.path, not a tree digest.

receiverSkillTreeSha256.description: ADMIT-time rederived complete installed receiver Skill tree digest. It must exactly equal the human-approved scopeCore.assignedReceiver.receiverSkillTreeSha256 using canonical-library-tree-v1 semantics; the entrypoint hash alone is insufficient.

expectedLoadedProcessClosureSha256.description: Exact human-approved scopeCore.assignedReceiver.expectedLoadedProcessClosureSha256 copied into the signed admission. No actual assigned-worker closure is asserted before semantic ADMIT PASS.

envelopeSha256.description: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the exact scopeCore.assignedReceiver object; every expected receiver field must match. Actual loaded identity is deferred to the admit-execution receipt.

receiver.description: Expected-only receiver binding. The assigned worker must not exist yet. After semantic PASS the authority consumes the admission token, launches it suspended/pre-entry, and records actual closure/identity in the separately signed admit-execution receipt.

authorizationChronology.description: Semantic validation requires authorizedAt <= admittedAt < authorizationExpiresAt and admittedAt < admissionExpiresAt.

nonce.description: Fresh cryptographic nonce. U+0000 is forbidden because tokenSha256 uses NUL-delimited framing.

tokenSha256.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 'W0-ADMIT-v1\0' + admission id + '\0' + w0RunId + '\0' + runAuthorization.scopeCoreSha256 + '\0' + nonce. Semantic validation rederives it; the raw capability is never stored here.

admitExecutionReceiptOutputs.description: Exact distinct predeclared operator-external output paths passed on ADMIT argv. Both must be absent before ADMIT semantic PASS, equal the future receipt's receiptOutputs, and remain outside/identity-disjoint from the project, B0-B2 snapshots, W0 package, creator/validator Skill, assigned receiver Skill, runtime temp, and every other authorization artifact. No hashes are included here, avoiding a receipt/admission cycle.

enforcement.description: pathScopeSha256, operationScopeSha256, and transferScopeSha256 are SHA-256 of canonical JSON for scopeCore.pathScope, scopeCore.operations, and scopeCore.transfer respectively. exactFrozenPaths must equal the freshly machine-derived W0 immutable project-path set (B0/B1/B2 manifests and physical snapshot members, W0 package, and all transitively reachable project-local handoff/proof evidence), with no missing or extra path. exactAllowedWritePaths must be disjoint under resolved Windows case-insensitive path, ancestor/descendant, and file-identity semantics. Exact path arrays, operations, denials, assignedReceiver Skill-tree digest, and expected closure digest must all match the authorization; actual worker closure is not available until the signed admit-execution receipt. Final-state similarity cannot hide an unauthorized event.

admissionLifetimeSeconds.description: Must equal admissionExpiresAt-admittedAt in whole seconds and be <= operator config immutableRuntimeAuthority.maxAdmissionLifetimeSeconds.

absolutePath.description: Windows local-drive absolute path for W0 lifecycle v1. POSIX, UNC, device, ADS, and relative paths are invalid.

allOf.description: Predeclared operator-external authorization/control path outside and identity-disjoint from project, every B0/B1/B2 snapshot, W0 package, creator/validator Skill, assigned receiver Skill, runtime temp, config/anchor, and other protected artifacts. Resolved aliases, links, reparses, mounts, containment, and hardlink identities are rejected.

Absolute installed assigned-receiver Skill entrypoint inside the receiver Skill tree bound by receiverSkillTreeSha256, but outside the project, all baseline snapshots, W0 package tree, installed creator/validator Skill, runtime temp, and operator-external authorization/evidence roots. ADMIT resolves path identities and rejects aliases, links, reparse points, mounts, hardlinks, and escapes.

projectPath.description: Same normalized Windows-safe project-relative path grammar as the human-approved run authorization; semantic validation also rejects case-folded, resolved-identity, and containment aliases.
